thread:
Alex Chen: quick standup — what I did / blockers / today

What I did: landed routing fix to staging (PR #4823), ran a small canary at ~2k TPS and validated functional correctness.
Blockers: seeing a flaky integ test (ingest-consistency) that occasionally times out; also release branch is behind main so cherry-pick needed.
Today: triage the flake, cherry-pick commit to the release branch, and hand off remaining merges to Sam.

Priya Nair: which release branch should the cherry-pick target? release/2026-03 or release/edge?

Mateo Ruiz: I'll pick this up. Planning to cherry-pick into release/2026-03 and open a backport PR. Steps:
```
git checkout release/2026-03
git fetch origin main
git cherry-pick 7a9c2f4
git push origin HEAD:release/2026-03
```
I'll tag the PR with @eng-releases and request a quick review.

Jing Park: FYI the integ flake shows this stack in the runner logs:
```
ERROR: ingest-consistency timeout after 60s
at com.redwood.ingest.Timer.waitFor
...
```
I can reproduce locally with a tight DB connection pool. Increasing timeout to 120s makes CI pass but I'm not sure that's the right fix.

Samira Patel: I can take the merge once Mateo opens the backport PR. Will run the smoke post-merge and hold for the scheduled canary. Also please add the QA checklist to the PR description (:memo:).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment window scheduled: 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC -> canary for 30m, roll to full if no regressions. :calendar:

Alex Chen: thanks — @Mateo please ping when PR is ready, @Samira I'll add the QA checklist now. If the integ flake is deeper, we can fall back to delaying the cherry if needed. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: noted — I'll watch CI and drop a quick review once the PR is up. :eyes:
